description: This file declares classes related to media key capabilities, including a factory class for creating media key capability instances and a client-side implementation class. It defines interfaces, class members, and methods for managing media key support and versions within a media application framework.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of media key capabilities.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Client-side implementation of media key capabilities, providing methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton media keys capabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported media key systems.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
